note: Curated, stable subset of the user-provided real-video corpus. Paths are relative to corpus_dir. source_sha256 is recorded for provenance and verified at run time; a mismatch is a warning, never a silent substitution. Raw clips are bounded to --frames before encoding; container clips are decoded to that many I420 frames with ffmpeg.

clips.label: Fortnite 1080p (ready I420 prefix)
clips.note: Exactly 1920x1080 I420, 128 frames; the reference anchor clip used for the documented 1080p numbers.
